name: Nightwalker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwalker must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. Undead are immune to this aura.

trait.name: Life Eater
entries: A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by the nightwalker and can't be revived except by a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Se o nightwalker falhar numa salvaguarda, pode escolher ter sucesso.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightwalker makes two Enervating Focus attacks, and it uses Finger of Doom if available.

action.name: Enervating Focus
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken.

action.name: Finger of Doom {@recharge 6}
entries: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage and become {@condition frightened} and {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the nightwalker's next turn.

fluffEntries: **O Avatar da Aniquilação:** preso no subsolo da Death House, derrete qualquer herói empurrado para o altar. Versão FATAL: PV integrais, Legendary Resistance e 3 ações lendárias. O círculo carmim de D28 apagado reduz a Aura para 4d6.

legendary.name: Movimento (1 Ação)
entries: Voa até metade do deslocamento sem provocar ataques de oportunidade.

legendary.name: Foco Enervante (2 Ações)
entries: Faz um ataque de Enervating Focus.

legendary.name: Dedo da Perdição (3 Ações)
entries: Usa Finger of Doom se estiver disponível.
